description: This file provides a PEAR DB emulation layer for ADODB, including class definitions, constants, and include statements to facilitate database abstraction and compatibility with PEAR DB interface.

classes.name: DB
classes.description: A factory and utility class for creating and managing database connections and configurations.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Creates a new database connection object for the specified database type.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the database using given DSN and options.

methods.name: apiVersion
methods.description: Returns the version number of the DB API.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Determines if a result is an error object.

methods.name: isWarning
methods.description: Determines if a result is a warning object (always returns false in this implementation).

methods.name: parseDSN
methods.description: Parses a Data Source Name string into its components.

methods.name: assertExtension
methods.description: Loads a PHP extension if it is not already loaded.
